_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment; ADR-031 declarative data, imperative check inside the existing post guards
_meta.description: Account.controlAccountFor names the sub-ledger that owns a control account; PostingRestriction holds an administration's blocked combinations of account, cost centre and project. PostingRestrictionGuard checks both on every posting a person makes, delegated from JournalEntryGuard::canPost and RuleComplianceGuard::validateTransaction. JournalEntry gains sourceApp (the sub-ledger a journal comes from) and a cost centre and project per line.

controlAccountFor.title: Control account for
controlAccountFor.description: The ledger that owns this account. Only that ledger posts to it; a journal entry by hand on it is refused.

description.title: Guidance
description.description: When to use this account; shown to the bookkeeper on every booking line.

sourceApp.title: Source ledger
sourceApp.description: The ledger this journal entry comes from. A bank booking may post its VAT line; a payroll journal may post on payroll accounts; an imported opening balance may post on every control account. Empty for an entry made by hand.

lines.title: Lines
lines.description: The entry's booking lines. Each line books an amount on one account, debit or credit, optionally on a cost centre and a project.

costCenterCode.title: Cost centre
costCenterCode.description: The cost centre this line is booked on.

projectCode.title: Project
projectCode.description: The project this line is booked on.

PostingRestriction.title: Posting restriction
PostingRestriction.description: A combination of account, cost centre and project that may not be booked together in this administration.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: A restriction decides which postings are refused, so every change to it is kept: who added, changed or retired it and when.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: The administration this restriction applies to.

accountPattern.title: Account
accountPattern.description: An account number, or its first digits to cover the accounts under it.

costCenterCode.title: Cost centre
costCenterCode.description: The cost centre this account may not be booked on. Empty covers every cost centre.

projectCode.title: Project
projectCode.description: The project this account may not be booked on. Empty covers every project.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the combination is blocked. The bookkeeper reads this when a posting is refused.

validFrom.title: Valid from
validFrom.description: The first posting date the restriction applies to.

validTo.title: Valid until
validTo.description: The last posting date the restriction applies to.

lifecycleState.title: State
lifecycleState.description: Only an active restriction blocks postings.

active.label: Active
active.description: Blocks the combination on new postings.

retired.label: Retired
retired.description: Kept for the record; blocks nothing.
